name: Shihlin Paper Corporation
summary: Shihlin Paper Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sales of paper-related products in Taiwan, Europe, and Asia. It sells paper processed products, wet wipes, facial masks, skin care products, and bath products. The company also engages in leasing of assets; investment and development; wholesale of daily necessities; and urban renewal and reconstruction activities. Shihlin Paper Corporation was founded in 1918 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
